description.value: Tentatsu is a Japanese sushi restaurant on East Hastings Street in Vancouver, offering a broad menu of nigiri, rolls, robata, sashimi, tempura, donburi, and combo platters. The restaurant emphasizes fresh fish and skilled preparation as its core offering. Online pickup ordering is available, making it convenient for cyclists passing through the area.

address.value: 2430 E Hastings St, Vancouver, BC V5K 1Z1
